Task / Business Action: Automated health-check probes for Kubernetes / Docker container self-healing
Business Outcome: Automatically restart crashed worker processes or web servers within 10 seconds of failure
Downstream Impact: Exposes /health/liveness/ and /health/readiness/ endpoints validating database and Redis connectivity
Notes: Standard health probe endpoints integrated with Docker Compose / Kubernetes restart policies.

Task / Business Action: Automated continuous WAL archiving and daily encrypted PostgreSQL pg_dump snapshot
Business Outcome: Zero-data-loss point-in-time recovery (PITR) capability in case of physical cloud hardware catastrophe
Downstream Impact: Uploads encrypted pg_dump and Write-Ahead Logs (WAL) to air-gapped S3 bucket with 30-day retention
Notes: Automated backup script with AES-256 encryption and automated test-restore health check.

Task / Business Action: Inbound Lead Exact-Match Deduplication & Conflict Prevention
Business Outcome: Enforces strict deduplication on incoming leads using normalized E.164 phone numbers and lowercase email addresses against existing CRM leads and active Customer masters.
Downstream Impact: Prevents multi-rep outreach collisions; appends new inquiry details and campaign tags to existing lead activity timeline rather than creating duplicate customer profiles.
Notes: Enforces database uniqueness constraints and deduplication matching rules across backend/crm/ models.

Business Outcome: Real-time accurate stock counts to prevent over-selling and identify inventory leakage
Downstream Impact: Maintains append-only StockMovement ledger; dynamically derives StockBalance per warehouse
Notes: Core system invariant: negative stock strictly blocked unless explicitly permitted by tenant policy.

Business Outcome: Maintain complete stock balances segregated by individual manufacturer batch lots
Downstream Impact: Maintains BatchLot records linked to Product; tracks quantity, inward date, and cost per batch

Business Outcome: Active monitoring of shelf-life across all pharmaceutical batches

Business Outcome: Strict system block preventing billing of medicines past their statutory expiration date
Downstream Impact: Validates item expiry against transaction date; hard-blocks invoice completion if expired
Notes: Core system invariant: billing expired BatchLot raises ValidationError and disables checkout.

Business Outcome: Single unified dashboard showing total stock holding across all godowns and regional hubs

Business Outcome: Check real-time warehouse available-to-promise (ATP) stock before confirming delivery dates

Business Outcome: Comprehensive view of current on-hand, committed, and available stock across all product lines

Business Outcome: Make formal manual stock adjustments for shrinkage, breakage, or opening stock corrections

Business Outcome: Enforce First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) rules and track impending shelf-life expirations

Task / Business Action: Database foreign key cascade deletion defense and soft-delete enforcement
Business Outcome: Prevent accidental cascading deletion of critical historical invoices when master entity is removed
Downstream Impact: Enforces on_delete=models.PROTECT on all transaction foreign keys; routes deletions to is_deleted=True
Notes: Core architectural invariant: models.PROTECT enforced across all financial and inventory FKs.

Task / Business Action: Pessimistic database locking on concurrent warehouse stock deduction
Business Outcome: Prevent negative inventory race condition when two cashiers bill the last remaining unit simultaneously
Downstream Impact: Executes SELECT FOR UPDATE on StockBalance row; serializes deduction; rejects second bill cleanly
Notes: Core concurrency invariant: atomic row-level lock on StockBalance during checkout.

Business Outcome: System hard-blocks checkout if any item in cart is past its statutory expiry date
Downstream Impact: Validates batch_lot.expiry_date against current date; raises blocking validation error
Notes: Core system invariant: billing expired stock is strictly blocked at API and UI layers.

Notes: E-Way Bill Part B vehicle update workflow recording transshipment reason and new vehicle RC.

Task / Business Action: Batch stock expired overnight: system automatically removes expired batch from active billing terminals

Downstream Impact: Prevents cashier accidentally selling expired medicine/food; creates quarantine movement to Expired Bin
Notes: Midnight cron worker scanning batch_lot.expiry_date < today; sets is_active=False on expired lots.
